req.title: Reject malformed player payload
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity when POST /players/ receives a body that fails Player schema validation.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject malformed player payloads with a 422 Unprocessable Entity status. This ensures data integrity by validating input against the defined schema. The test suite includes positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive coverage of the requirement.

tests.name: test_valid_player_creation
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with valid player data.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a valid player payload.
expected: The response contains the created player data.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

valid_payload = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Forward"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=valid_payload)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["firstName"] == "John"
assert response.json()["lastName"] == "Doe"
assert response.json()["squadNumber"] == 27
assert response.json()["position"] == "Forward"

tests.name: test_malformed_player_payload
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with valid player data.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a malformed player payload.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating validation failure.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

malformed_payload = {
    "firstName": "",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Forward"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=malformed_payload)
assert response.status_code == 422
assert "validation error" in response.text

tests.name: test_boundary_player_payload
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with valid player data.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a player payload having maximum length strings.
expected: The response contains the created player data with maximum length strings.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

boundary_payload = {
    "firstName": "X" * 50,
    "lastName": "X" * 50,
    "squadNumber": 28,
    "position": "X" * 30
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=boundary_payload)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["firstName"] == "X" * 50
assert response.json()["lastName"] == "X" * 50
assert response.json()["squadNumber"] == 28
assert response.json()["position"] == "X" * 30
